text:
Priya Sharma: RCA published for the control-plane slowdown on 2026-03-20 — link: https://redwood.internal/rca/2065432100 :link:

Priya Sharma: TL;DR — root cause: delayed KV cache invalidation + a client-side retry storm that amplified backpressure. Impact window ~ 14:03-14:38 UTC, elevated 99th pct latency and partial routing degradations.

Priya Sharma: Top action items (short):
- Samir: implement safer cache invalidation gate (feature flagged) — target: 2026-03-27
- Tracy: add route-level backpressure telemetry and alerts (pager threshold) — target: 2026-03-24
- Liam: churn test harness for client retry logic + regression test in CI — target: 2026-04-02
- Infra: capacity headroom playbook + pre-scale rule for spike > 2x QPS — target: 2026-03-28

Liam Chen: ack — thanks for the write-up, Priya. Can you confirm which service owns the KV cache change?

Priya Sharma: Samir owns the cache change; it was a recent refactor in serving-runtime v2.1. It bypassed the invalidation gate in a narrow path.

Samir Patel: I can take the gate work. Will open a PR today. Question: do we want the flag default ON or OFF? I'd prefer OFF to be safe for canary first.

Priya Sharma: OFF by default, canary to 10% in Dedicated region, rollout plan in the RCA near the bottom.

Tracy Gomez: I can take the telemetry. I'll add route-level histograms + an alert if route 99p > 300ms for 5m. Can someone give me the route list to start?

Liam Chen: I'll paste a minimal list in the thread. Also propose adding a synthetic canary that exercises the common prefix to catch cache-invalid paths.

Priya Sharma: Thanks — Liam, please add the synthetic tests to the CI bucket `ci/churn-controlplane`. Tracy, I've added the route list doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/route-list (perm: eng).

ops-bot: Created tickets: RW-3458 (cache-invalidation gate), RW-3459 (route telemetry), RW-3460 (client-retry-regression). Linked to RCA 2065432100.

Tracy Gomez: FYI I set a draft alert: `controlplane.route.99p` on PagerDuty escalation policy `sre-core`. Will iterate with SRE.

Samir Patel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/serving-runtime/pulls/1289 — includes feature flag + unit tests. Requesting review from @Priya and @Liam.

Liam Chen: Reviewing now. Quick note: add an integration test that simulates concurrent invalidation + read to reproduce.

Priya Sharma: Scheduling a 30m follow-up checkpoint to go over progress and unblock owners: Friday 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC. Please RSVP if you need a different slot.

Tracy Gomez: I can do that.

Samir Patel: I'll be there.

Liam Chen: Works for me.

Priya Sharma: Final notes in RCA: rollback thresholds, canary checklist, owners + contact list. If you spot anything missing in the tickets or action items, reply here and I'll update.

Tracy Gomez: One request — add a short post-deploy verification script for canary rollout (latency, error-rate, KV hit-rate). I'll draft it after the telemetry is in.

Priya Sharma: Perfect — add it to RW-3459 and CC me.

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone.

Liam Chen: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: 1 day before the checkpoint meeting, a calendar invite will be posted.

Priya Sharma: Closing the thread for now; we'll keep updates in the RCA and the follow-up meeting notes.
